invariants: learner wording and original target are preserved
open and resolved describe a personal question, never mastery or task completion

payload_schema.title: payload for capability atlas.question.save
payload_schema.description: Derived from the los CLI parser for this capability's named command. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with tools/generate_capability_schemas.py.

id.description: Durable note id the question lives on; an unknown id starts a new question note.

title.description: Question title; required for a new question.

text.description: Question body; required for a new question.

target.description: What the question is about, shaped as note atlas_question.target in system/schema/note.schema.json: {concepts: [...]} or {from, type, to}. Required for a new question; preserved, never changed, on an existing one.

state.description: open or resolved, per note atlas_question.state; new questions start open.

answer_notes.description: Durable note ids answering the question; each must resolve to another durable note.

question.description: the explicitly authored question to save or resolve: id is required, and new questions also need title, text and target
